top_signals.title: Yen Rises as Intervention, BOJ Rate Hike Risks Jolt Traders
top_signals.summary: The yen strengthened nearly 2% Thursday, reversing a month of gradual decline, as traders lifted bets on Bank of Japan interest-rate hikes and remained vigilant to the risk of official action to further boost the currency.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Appointment of Chair and Deputy Chair of the Enforcement Decision Making Committee (EDMC)
top_signals.summary: Following an external recruitment process, the Bank of England (the Bank) has appointed Nicholas Segal as Chair of its Enforcement Decision Making Committee (EDMC), and Peter King as Deputy Chair, with effect from 1 August 2026.

top_signals.title: SEC Moves to Nix Rule on Investment Adviser, Political Donations
top_signals.summary: Investment advisers would no longer be prohibited from offering services to public pension funds if they made recent political donations to state and local elected officials, under a proposal released Thursday from the Securities and Exchange Commission.
